prisoners.name: Scott Sakiyama
prisoners.description: Scott Sakiyama is an Oak Park attorney detained by federal immigration agents on October 20, 2025 while following their vehicles and warning neighbors with his horn and a whistle. He told the Chicago Tribune that agents held him for about an hour, largely in a parked van outside the Broadview facility, then returned him to his car with a citation. He disputed their allegation that he cut off their vehicle.

cases.charges: Violation notice alleging interference with federal officers under 18 U.S.C. 111(a)
cases.sentence: Approximately one hour in federal custody; released with a citation. No sentence or conviction established by the reviewed sources. Subsequent citation outcome and exact release calendar date remain unset. Sources: https://www.pulitzer.org/winners/staff-chicago-tribune (Tribune interview, Bizarre behavior section); https://storage.courtlistener.com/recap/gov.uscourts.ilnd.487571/gov.uscourts.ilnd.487571.284.40.pdf (page 2, Scott Tadashi Sakiyama, October 20). The historical chart custody flag is not used to establish present custody; actual release is supported by his interview.
